# NAMI Greater Mississippi Valley

> NAMI Greater Mississippi Valley provides mental health education, support groups, and resources for families and caregivers in Eastern Iowa and Western Illinois.

The organization offers evidence-based programs including Family-to-Family courses, Family & Friends seminars, and NAMI Homefront for military families. Support groups meet both virtually via Zoom and in-person at locations throughout the region including Davenport, Rock Island, Muscatine County, Clinton, and DeWitt.

## Key Topics

- Family support groups
- Caregiver of youth support
- Mental health education programs
- Family-to-Family courses
- Youth mental health
- Virtual support meetings via Zoom
- Parent caregivers
- Mental illness education
- NAMI Family & Friends Seminar
- NAMI Homefront for military families
- Eastern Iowa Mental Health Region
- Community mental health awareness
- Peer-led support groups
- Adult mental illness support
- Mental health conditions resources

## About & Leadership

- [Board of Directors](https://www.namigmv.org/about/board-of-directors): NAMI GMV leadership team including Brandon Kutmas and Joy Summerlin

## Support Groups

- [NAMI Family Support Group](https://www.namigmv.org/event/11381-2/2023-10-19): Monthly peer-led support group at St. Paul Lutheran Church, Davenport
- [Virtual Family Support Group](https://www.namigmv.org/event/virtual-family-support-group-5): Monthly virtual support group for families led by Deb Frick & Tami Bogosian
- [NAMI Caregiver of Youth Support Group (Virtual)](https://www.namigmv.org/event/nami-caregiver-of-youth-support-group-9): Virtual support group for parents of youth with mental illness via Zoom
- [NAMI Caregiver of Youth Support Group (In Person)](https://www.namigmv.org/event/nami-caregiver-of-youth-support-group-in-person): In-person youth caregiver support group at Mighty Fortress Community Church
- [Virtual Caregiver of Youth Support Group](https://www.namigmv.org/event/virtual-caregiver-of-youth-support-group-2): Virtual support group for caregivers of youth with mental health conditions
- [NAMI Caregiver of Youth Support Group](https://www.namigmv.org/event/nami-caregiver-of-youth-support-group-7): Virtual Zoom support group for parents of youth with mental illness

## Education Programs

- [NAMI Family & Friends Seminar at Trinity Lutheran](https://www.namigmv.org/event/nami-family-friends-seminar-at-trinity-lutheran): Free NAMI Family & Friends Seminar at Trinity Lutheran, funded by RICF
- [Family to Family Course - Clinton](https://www.namigmv.org/event/1st-day-of-class-family-to-family-clinton): First day of 12-week NAMI Family-to-Family course in Clinton
- [Education for Families - Davenport](https://www.namigmv.org/event/education-for-families-supporting-an-adult-with-a-mental-illness-davenport): 8-session family education program in Davenport for adult mental illness
- [Education for Families - DeWitt](https://www.namigmv.org/event/education-for-families-supporting-an-adult-with-a-mental-illness-muscatine-3): 8-session family education program in DeWitt for adult mental illness
- [NAMI Homefront Registration Deadline](https://www.namigmv.org/event/registration-deadline-nami-homefront-at-ri-arsenal-asqc-hq): Registration deadline for NAMI Homefront program for military families

## Community Events & Fundraisers

- [Baristas & Fashionistas Fun for a Cause](https://www.namigmv.org/baristas-fashionistas-fun-for-a-cause): Fundraiser with coffee, boutiques & Donovan Gustafson for mental health
- [MLK Jr. Community Bike Ride](https://www.namigmv.org/event/visit-with-us-at-mlk-jr-community-bike-ride): NAMI GMV outreach at MLK Jr. Community Bike Ride in Rock Island
- [NAACP Community Day & Resource Fair](https://www.namigmv.org/event/naacp-community-day-resource-fair): NAMI GMV outreach at NAACP Resource Fair at MLK Community Center
- [VA Summit in Coralville](https://www.namigmv.org/event/visit-with-us-at-va-summit-in-coralville): NAMI GMV outreach at Veterans Administration Summit in Coralville
